guarantee.statement: With probability at least 95% over the tuning data, P(wrong | ACCEPT) is at most 5.00% on future traffic that is exchangeable with it.
assumptions: Future traffic is exchangeable with the tuning window.
The outcomes in the tuning split are correct.
A decision that fired without an outcome counts as wrong.
